page.overview:
Who is Partner Pokémon?

Partner Pokémon are special Pokémon that the player have as their first partners in for the Nintendo Switch, the Generation VII remakes of the Generation I Game Boy title . The particular Pokémon in those games are Pikachu and Eevee. The Partner Pokémon are also the ones to use Secret Techniques and exclusive moves in the games. Unlike their regular kinds, the Partner Pokémon are unique, as they serve to share their feelings with the player, always have maximum IVs and a distinctive appearance. The Partner Pokémon can only be the starters of the player in the game that they are received in; Partner Pikachu can only be received in Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu!, while Partner Eevee can only be received in Pokémon: Let's Go, Eevee!. They themselves are also the version mascots.

{| class="article-table" ! Partner Pikachu ! Partner Eevee

These are the Exclusive Moves that only the Partner Pokémon can use. They can learn them via Move Tutor, and can activate partner powers in battle once they have high enough friendship. The Partner Pokémon's Exclusive Moves cannot be used in other games, as they are only exclusive to Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee!.
